cli.rule: each flag in flags order whose value differs from defaults: a true bool as the flag alone, a false bool as flag=false, a value matching plain as is, any other in single quotes; the token never, which the command reads from the variable tokenEnv, to be exported before it runs

rules.disk: tmpfs when ephemeral, else the disk as given
rules.extractTimeoutS: extractTimeout in seconds: digits then s, m (x60) or h (x3600)
rules.memLimitMB: memLimitMB when not 0; else ceil(rateHz * bufferS * approxLineBytes * memLimitRingFactorHalves / 2 / 2^20), at least minMemLimitMB, and at most memoryMax * memoryCapNumerator / memoryCapDenominator in MiB (rounded down) when that ceiling is above the ring's own MiB (rounded down)
rules.registryHost: the host remoteRef names; empty without remoteImage
rules.remoteRef: empty without remoteImage; else registryHost + '/' + the rest, where the first path component is the host when it holds a dot or a colon or is localhost, a Docker Hub alias becomes dockerHubHost, and a Docker Hub name with no '/' gains 'library/'
rules.startOnBoot: yes or no as given; for auto, no when ephemeral, else yes

manifest.rule:
the value manifest is each line of manifest.header, then of the manifest field of each step whose when holds, in step order, joined with the two characters 
, and a final 
; RouterOS stores each 
 inside the quoted string as a newline

script: each line of scriptHeader, then of scriptGuards, then for each step whose when holds the line "# " + name and the line create, then each line of scriptFooter; every line ends with a newline

scriptFooter.text: :if ([:len [/container/find comment="{{tag}}" running]] > 0) do={ :put "mikroscope: agent running, http://{{containerIP}}:{{port}}/healthz" } else={ :put "mikroscope: not running yet; see /log/print where topics~\"container\"" }
# When it is done: /container/print where comment="{{tag}}"
# The agent answers on http://{{containerIP}}:{{port}}/healthz from the router's LAN.

scriptGuards.text: :if (!([/system/resource/get version] ~ "^(7[.](2[4-9]|[3-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9][0-9])|([89]|[1-9][0-9]+)[.])")) do={ :error "mikroscope: needs RouterOS 7.24 or later" }
:if ([:len [/system/package/find name="container" disabled=no]] = 0) do={ :error "mikroscope: the container package is not installed" }
:local dm [:tostr [/system/device-mode/get container]]; :if ($dm != "yes" && $dm != "true") do={ :error "mikroscope: device-mode container is not enabled" }
:if ([:len [/interface/veth/find name="{{veth}}"]] > 0 && [:len [/interface/veth/find name="{{veth}}" comment="{{tag}}"]] = 0) do={ :error "mikroscope: veth {{veth}} exists and is not mikroscope's" }

:if ([:len [/container/envs/find list="{{envList}}"]] > 0 && [:len [/container/envs/find list="{{envList}}" key="MIKROSCOPE_TAG" value="{{tag}}"]] = 0) do={ :error "mikroscope: envlist {{envList}} exists and is not mikroscope's" }

:if ([:len [/container/find name="{{containerName}}"]] > 0 && [:len [/container/find name="{{containerName}}" comment="{{tag}}"]] = 0) do={ :error "mikroscope: a container named {{containerName}} exists and is not mikroscope's" }
:if ([:len [/interface/list/find name="{{ifaceList}}"]] = 0) do={ :error "mikroscope: interface list {{ifaceList}} does not exist" }
:if ([:len [/disk/find slot="{{disk}}"]] = 0) do={ :error "mikroscope: disk {{disk}} does not exist" }

:if ([:len [/file/find name="{{manifestFile}}"]] > 0) do={ :if (!([:typeof [:find [/file/get [find name="{{manifestFile}}"] contents] "\ntag={{tag}}\n"]] = "num")) do={ :error "mikroscope: {{manifestFile}} exists and is not this install's manifest" } }

scriptHeader.text: # mikroscope {{version}}: install script for RouterOS 7.24 or later. Container name: {{name}}
# Every object it creates carries the comment "{{tag}}", which is how
# `mikroscope status` and `uninstall` recognize them later. It lists them in
# {{manifestFile}} on the router, which `mikroscope uninstall` reads and deletes last.
# The registry host is part of remote-image= (RouterOS 7.18 and later take it
# there), so this script neither reads nor changes the device-wide registry-url.
# A registry username set on the device for a registry other than {{registryHost}}
# can make the pull end in `auth error`; `mikroscope doctor` warns about it.
# BEFORE RUNNING: put the agent image tar on the device as {{imageFile}}
# (upload it over WinBox/WebFig Files, or /tool/fetch it), or regenerate this
# script with --remote-image so the router pulls the image instead.
# The agent's bearer token is in clear below: treat this file as a credential.
# It runs as one block: a check that fails stops it before anything is written,
# and a step that fails stops the steps after it.

create.text: :local m "{{manifest}}"; :if ([:len [/file/find name="{{manifestFile}}"]] > 0) do={ /file/set [find name="{{manifestFile}}"] contents=$m } else={ /file/add name="{{manifestFile}}" contents=$m }

owned.text: :if ([:len [/file/find name="{{manifestFile}}"]] > 0) do={ :if ([:typeof [:find [/file/get [find name="{{manifestFile}}"] contents] "\ntag={{tag}}\n"]] = "num") do={ :put 1 } else={ :put 0 } } else={ :put 0 }

present.text: :if ([:len [/file/find name="{{manifestFile}}"]] > 0) do={ :if ([/file/get [find name="{{manifestFile}}"] contents] = "{{manifest}}") do={ :put 1 } else={ :put 0 } } else={ :put 0 }
